_comment: READ-ONLY profile (CFG-506). The deny list is the ACTUAL guarantee — an abliterated 7B has no refusal behaviour, so restriction must be enforced by the harness, not requested in a prompt. Bash is denied ENTIRELY and deliberately: `echo x > f`, `python3 -c "open(...,'w')"` and a hundred other spellings make any Bash allowlist leaky. Read/Grep/Glob cover reading and searching, which is the whole job. Do not add Bash back to make something convenient.
